feature_notes: Adds live Cell.number_format, style_id, has_style and format-aware is_date backed by the canonical Rust style bank, plus explicit WriteOnlyCell.number_format and empty styled cells. New-workbook saves export their actual style catalog; loaded edits preserve unrelated style components, register new format codes and rewrite the relationship-resolved stylesheet repeatably. Explicit General dates reload as integers, and retained deleted/overwritten cell aliases keep value/format snapshots. Fixes repeated loaded-sheet validation discovered during profiling. All 547 existing compatibility cases, Ruff and strict Clippy pass. Verified 100,000-cell create/edit/save and write-only operations are faster and lower-RSS than openpyxl in recorded serial measurements; all outputs and temp cleanup are checked. Includes the selected native formula-token compatibility checkpoint. Pins the exact published Rust alpha.9 revision. Complete style components and deferred M4/M5/M6 graphs remain planned; unsupported signed/data-only/unknown-style/missing-stylesheet/affected-graph cases reject explicitly. Five platforms and CPython 3.11–3.15 remain required wheel gates, with OIDC publication.
